items.text: Flamethrower fuel gauge now correctly tracks fuel.
Mid‑reload magazine bug fixed for smoother weapon reloads.
Uzi turn‑loop/spinning issue resolved, preventing stuck rotation when aiming.
Patrol helicopter rockets restored to proper functionality.
PT Boat front turret balance adjusted for better handling.
Procedural generation fixes improve rivers, water pipes, inland spawns, train entrances, underwater flora, and terrain gaps.
Added TerrainHeightRaise objects to underground train tunnel junctions, preventing terrain collisions that could kill players or items.
Door placement and destruction now refresh only the modified door, reducing unnecessary server updates.
Deployable logic now checks only the most recent building block changes, improving building reliability.
Base occlusion visual bugs fixed: contents correctly hidden behind closed ladder hatches, armored doors with open hatches, and shut industrial garage doors.
Room‑occluded entities now produce audible sounds, restoring expected sound cues inside bases.
Fixed river source gaps, improving water flow consistency.
Prevented terrain from being raised around rivers, preserving natural riverbanks.
Added underwater grass and rocks, restoring expected underwater resources.
Restored missing train entrance structures, ensuring train travel works as intended.
Adjusted inland spawn locations for better resource distribution.
Improved river avoidance logic, reducing unnatural terrain intersections.
Fixed a bug where players could not dismount from computer stations.
Corrected off‑center snapping, allowing structures to align properly when placed.
Fixed water pipe structures spawning on roads, removing obstruction for road building and vehicle movement.

items.text: Prevent new players from spawning under the sea.

Increase deploy and clear bounds for sleeping bags and towels to improve placement.

Correct silencer muzzle offsets for all weapons.
Add dynamic monument map markers that can update label text and position at runtime.

Corrected settings color dropdowns so they close properly after selection.
Fixed lingering first‑person view elements in the shoulder camera during extraction, removing visual artifacts.
Adjusted tattoo stencil sizing to use screen space, aligning head and body tattoo sizes correctly.
Patched a null reference error during weapon spin‑up, preventing crashes and ensuring consistent firing.

items.text: Backpack items are now included in all inventory searches and item transfers, streamlining crafting and item management.
Supplier missions, in‑raid crafting lists, and shop listings have been fixed, ensuring reliable mission rewards and crafting options.
Contraband loot tier has been rebalanced for a more consistent reward curve.
2‑module car prefabs now have correct IDs, eliminating errors when deploying those vehicles.
A crash caused by loading a vine that had already finished swinging has been resolved, improving overall stability.
Cobalt tattoo stencil pack now unlocks its stencils directly via the Steam item, making the new designs immediately usable.
Watercatcher and chicken coop loot panels now automatically select the bucket when it’s in the belt, and disabled blueprints display a clear “cannot learn” tooltip.
Sleeping bag respawns no longer trap players in tight spaces, and respawning on a bag now requires clicking the bag, preventing accidental stuck situations.
Loot reveal order at extraction now shows forward items first and the best last, with adjusted reveal range for smoother looting.
Extraction balloons are now indestructible, ensuring they remain functional throughout the extraction phase.
New balloon doors, Burn & Extract mechanic, hub sounds, and balloon platforms with consoles and sirens have been added to the extraction hub, expanding interactive elements.
Bandit patrols cover a wider area, guards will search for lost players, and a door‑unlock cue has been added for clearer navigation.
Hidden shop unlocks, a hub radio, and a fixed shop scroll UI enhance the outpost’s commerce experience.
Turn‑in‑place animation no longer restarts when equipping items mid‑turn.
Sleeping bags no longer get stuck on respawn, ensuring proper placement.

2026-11-17.summary:
### Inventory & Crafting

- Supplier missions, in‑raid crafting lists, and shop listings have been fixed, ensuring reliable mission rewards and crafting options.

- Sleeping bag respawns no longer trap players in tight spaces, and respawning on a bag now requires clicking the bag, preventing accidental stuck situations.

### Extraction Hub Overhaul
- Loot reveal order at extraction now shows forward items first and the best last, with adjusted reveal range for smoother looting.
- Extraction balloons are now indestructible, ensuring they remain functional throughout the extraction phase.
- New balloon doors, Burn & Extract mechanic, hub sounds, and balloon platforms with consoles and sirens have been added to the extraction hub, expanding interactive elements.
- Bandit patrols cover a wider area, guards will search for lost players, and a door‑unlock cue has been added for clearer navigation.
- Hidden shop unlocks, a hub radio, and a fixed shop scroll UI enhance the outpost’s commerce experience.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Turn‑in‑place animation no longer restarts when equipping items mid‑turn.
- Sleeping bags no longer get stuck on respawn, ensuring proper placement.
